headline: Grumpy Walrus bought ~505.7 ASCEND 10:59 AM-12:00 PM ET (five ~71 ADA clips plus two 250k MEPE swaps, ~548 ADA equivalent), added ~322 NIGHT (~70 ADA) and sent ~400 ADA to an outside wallet; net ADA ~-763; ASCEND bag ~325.6k. ASCEND side recovered to ~1.057M (~40.9% above the 750k line); stays Watch. DEXY sinks deeper under its kill lines (side ~3.3k, 40 holders, no trades 24h); Pass. COCK side ~134.8k (10.1% under). Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: Grumpy Walrus split a ~548 ADA ASCEND add into five identical ~71 ADA clips plus MEPE swaps, so whale size shows up only when the clips are summed, not in any single swap.
